sub_indicators.label: Startup law and funding
sub_indicators.subject: tech.innovate
sub_indicators.text: Tech startup ecosystem: startup law and funding
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Digital Transformation Strategy and the AU Startup Model Law Framework ask for a national startup law and strategy across seven areas, an innovation fund and angel networks.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no startup law, strategy or public support for startups exists.
A startup bill is drafted or tabled, or a startup strategy is being written or in consultation.
A startup act is passed or a startup strategy adopted.
Startups are labelled or registered under the act or strategy, or its tax or other measures are applied to them.
A public or public-backed fund set up under the act or strategy has financed startups, with investments named or counted.
